protocol.buildMode: vite build (production bundle) served by vite preview; dev server never used
protocol.pairing: per repetition both arms run adjacently; baseline/candidate order alternates per repetition
protocol.coldWarm: repetition 0 runs each arm in a fresh browser context (cold; the browser process is shared and per-context HTTP cache is empty); repetitions 1+ re-navigate one persistent page (warm)
protocol.outOfScope: cancellation interactions, cache/replay/recolor distributions, and catalog shard states are out of scope for this first Stage A pass
protocol.wallMetric: requestToPresentMs of the computed stable frame (plan §8 fresh delivery timing)
protocol.hashByteOrder: SHA-256 over row-major RGBA bytes from getImageData(0, 0, width, height) of canvas.explorer__canvas
protocol.engineLabels: chromium = branded stable Google Chrome, firefox = branded stable Firefox, both headed with DevTools closed, on the declared target hardware (the machine running this harness)
protocol.powerMode: AC, platform profile balanced (read from /sys at the end of the run)
protocol.deviceScaleFactor: every context is created with deviceScaleFactor 1 so the canvas raster is exactly the shipping 1024x640 raster
protocol.pairedIntervals: 95% BCa bootstrap on warm pairs, 10000 resamples, seed 20261011 (tools/benchmark/bca.ts): median log-ratio ln(legacy/candidate) for the speed ratio, median candidate−legacy difference for the regression cap
